describes: Current form mirror status, actual pending confirmation/refusal and field permission gate.

cases.name: formReducer/set-status
cases.covers: The real fields mirror is loading before its deferred list answers, then ready; no session SET_STATUS exists.

cases.name: formReducer/set-status-unchanged-is-no-change
cases.covers: A ready read stays ready across a refresh with identical fields; the empty session state emits no changes.

cases.name: current-form-confirmation-refusal-and-permission
cases.covers: Without annotation, a fill is predicted, confirmed once before resolution, then a refused fill leaves the confirmed value. A second document denies fill locally.
